description.zh: 创建代理运行时请求参数
description.en: The request parameters for creating an agent runtime.

descriptions.zh: 创建一个新的智能体运行时实例，用于执行AI代理任务。智能体运行时是AgentRun服务的核心组件，提供代码执行、浏览器操作、内存管理等能力。
descriptions.en: Creates an agent runtime instance to execute AI agent tasks. The agent runtime is a core component of the AgentRun service and provides capabilities such as code execution, browser operations, and memory management.
